Equipment.DropHint: Drag weapons, armour, shields, gear and containers from the Items sidebar onto this sheet.

Item.QuantityHint: How many you carry, such as 6 torches or 10 iron nails. Each one counts towards cumbersome items and container space. Lower it by hand when you use one up.
Item.CumbersomeHint: Counts towards your cumbersome limit: things too unwieldy to carry with ease, such as a two-handed weapon, a heavy shield, armour you are not wearing, a barrel or a body. The Dark Master decides what is cumbersome. Armour you are wearing never counts.

Weapon.ZeroHint: Leave a number at 0 if the weapon does not have that trait.

Trait.agileHint: The Bane for attacking more than once in a turn starts only after your second attack.
Trait.finesseHint: Choose whether to attack with Agility or Strength.
Trait.versatileHint: Can be used one-handed, but attacks are +2 DR.
Trait.reachHint: Melee reach in feet instead of 5′.
Trait.thrownHint: Can be thrown without Bane up to this many feet. It must be retrieved before it is used again.
Trait.rangedHint: Bane when firing at something farther away than this many feet.
Trait.expendableHint: Roll this die after use (for ammunition, after a combat in which it was used). On a 1 it is used up.

Armour.MetalHint: Metal armour of tier 2 or heavier gives Bane on spellcasting. Tier 2 and up starts as metal; untick it for hide, leather and other non-metal armour.
Armour.TierHint: Damage lowers the current tier. Repairs can never raise it above the original tier.

Shield.Hint: Use an action to gain light or heavy cover until the start of your next turn.

Test.BoonHint: Roll two d20 and keep the higher.
Test.BaneHint: Roll two d20 and keep the lower. Boon and Bane together cancel out.
Test.AidHint: +1 for each ally who succeeded, −1 for each who failed, from −2 to +2 in total.
Test.ArmourDialogNote: {name}: {armour} DR on Agility tests, added for you.
Test.EncumberedBane: Encumbered: Bane on Strength and Agility tests.

Contest.Tooltip: Roll against an opponent: the higher total wins
Contest.FoeHint: A foe rolls a plain d20 and adds nothing. Its name is only used on the card.
Contest.CharacterHint: The opponent's ability, Boon and Bane count only when the opponent is a character.
Contest.Tie: A tie: no victor, the struggle goes on

Expendable.Tooltip: Roll the expendable die ({die}): on a 1 it is used up
Expendable.UsedUpHint: Ticked when the expendable die rolls a 1 on the last one. Untick it if the item is refilled.
Expendable.OutOfAmmoHint: Ticked when the expendable die rolls a 1. The weapon cannot be reloaded until you untick it, for example after buying a new supply of ammunition.

Reload.LoadedHint: A weapon with Reload must be reloaded after each shot.
Reload.FireTooltip: Fire: the weapon is empty until reloaded
Reload.ActionsSpent: Spend {count} Interact actions to reload. The weapon is loaded.

Examples.Label: Import examples
Examples.Hint: Create the example documents used to test the system, or reset them to their saved values if they are already in this world.
Examples.Title: Import examples
Examples.Explanation: This creates every example in the world. Examples that are already here are updated to their saved values, so any changes you made to them are lost.
Examples.GMOnly: Only the GM can import examples.
Examples.Failed: The examples could not be imported. Press F12 and look in the console for details.

Container.Hint: A container lets you find what you need. It does not raise your cumbersome limit.

Hint.normal: You can carry cumbersome items up to your Toughness (minimum 1). Other items do not count.
Hint.encumbered: Encumbered: all terrain counts as difficult terrain, and Bane on Strength and Agility tests.
Hint.overloaded: More than twice your cumbersome limit: your movement is 0. You are also Encumbered: Bane on Strength and Agility tests.

Feat.ImprovingHint: Tick this if the feat was chosen when Improving. Only these feats raise the DR of the Death’s Door Sanity test.

Foe.MoraleHint: Roll 2d6: above its Morale, the foe is demoralised. A foe with Morale – never rolls.
Foe.ArmourHint: Subtracted from damage that hits the foe.
Foe.InitiativeHint: Added to the foe’s d6 initiative roll. It comes from the foe’s passives, so type it in when a passive grants one.
Foe.MookHint: A mook has 1 HP, fails every test and never rolls Morale. It keeps its attacks and passives but has no gloom abilities.
Foe.DropHint: Drag weapons (attacks) and feats (passives) from the Items sidebar onto this sheet, or use the Add buttons.
Foe.AttackHint: A foe’s attack: melee or ranged, its damage, and its reach or range. Foe attacks have no other traits and no expendable die.
Foe.RangeHint: How far the ranged attack reaches, such as 60 for (60′).
Foe.ReachHint: Melee reach in feet, such as 10 for (reach 10′). Leave at 0 for the usual 5′.

Combat.PipsLeft: {label}: {left} of {max} left. Click a filled pip to spend it, an empty one to give it back.

Attack.BeyondRangeHint: Tick if the target is farther away than {distance}. Bane.
Attack.AutomaticHint: Attacks are DR12. Heavy, one-handed, armour and Encumbered are added for you.
Attack.ArmourNote: {armour} DR for armour ({name}) on an Agility attack
Attack.MultipleNote: You have already attacked this turn: Bane.
Attack.MultipleNoteAgile: You have already attacked twice this turn: Bane, even with an agile weapon.
Attack.TurnNote: Your turn. Attacks made so far this turn: {count}. This attack uses an action.
Attack.ReactionNote: Not your turn: this attack uses your reaction and does not count towards the multiple-attack Bane.
Attack.NoTarget: No target. Target a token to name it on the card and lower its armour on a Triumph.

Outcome.triumph: Double damage, and the foe’s armour is reduced by one tier.
Outcome.ruin: Your weapon jams or your grip falters: Bane on attacks until you spend an action to recover.

Attack.BadDamage: Damage “{formula}” is not a dice formula. Roll it by hand.
Attack.GMOnly: Only the Dark Master can change this foe.
Attack.Retrieve: A thrown weapon must be retrieved before it can be used again.
Attack.NoActions: No actions left this turn. The attack is rolled anyway; the Dark Master decides.
Attack.NoReaction: No reaction left. The attack is rolled anyway; the Dark Master decides.
Attack.RuinNote: Your last attack was a Ruin: Bane until you Recover.
Attack.RuinBane: Ruin not yet recovered from: Bane.
Attack.RuinedNow: Bane on your attacks until you press Recover on your sheet (one action).
Attack.RuinedHint: Bane on attacks until you Recover. In combat this uses one action (◈) on your turn.
Attack.Recovered: {name} recovers from the Ruin. Attacks no longer have Bane from it.
Attack.RecoverNotYourTurn: Recovering uses an action, so in combat you can only do it on your own turn.
Attack.RecoverNoActions: No actions left this turn. Recovering anyway; the Dark Master decides.
